name: diffseek
description: DiffSeek is a subtle GitHub ergonomics facelift for reviewing pull requests. It improves the existing **Files changed** file tree without replacing GitHub's review model.

scripts.build-for-amo: corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && wxt zip -b firefox --config config/wxt.config.ts
scripts.check:ci:full: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names quality,e2e "pnpm check:ci:quality" "pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps --no-shell chromium && pnpm build && pnpm test:e2e:run"
scripts.check:ci:quality: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names rules,binaries,escape,subjects,knip,types,coverage,audit "pnpm lint:rules" "pnpm lint:binaries" "pnpm lint:escape" "pnpm lint:subjects" "pnpm lint:knip" "pnpm typecheck" "pnpm coverage:ci" "pnpm audit:ci"
scripts.check:commit: pnpm lint:staged && pnpm lint:rules && pnpm lint:binaries:staged && pnpm lint:escape && pnpm lint:subjects
scripts.check:strict: concurrently --names eslint,jscpd,deps,coverage,style,webext "pnpm lint:ci" "pnpm lint:jscpd" "pnpm lint:deps" "pnpm lint:type-coverage" "pnpm lint:style" "pnpm lint:webext"
scripts.lint:deps: depcruise --config config/dependency-cruiser.json --output-type err src entrypoints scripts config
scripts.lint:jscpd: jscpd --config config/jscpd.json src scripts config entrypoints --exit-code
scripts.lint:webext: wxt build -b firefox --config config/wxt.config.ts && web-ext lint --source-dir .output/firefox-mv3 --pretty --warnings-as-errors
scripts.zip:firefox: wxt zip -b firefox --config config/wxt.config.ts && git archive --format=zip --output=.output/diffseek-$(node --input-type=module -e 'import {readFileSync} from "node:fs"; process.stdout.write(JSON.parse(readFileSync(".output/firefox-mv3/manifest.json","utf8")).version)')-sources.zip HEAD
